WITH pair_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    sf.transref,
    t.tradekind,
    AVG(sf.anlycount) as avg_analyst_count
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals sf
  JOIN transactionrecord tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  WHERE sf.anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sf.transref, t.tradekind
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) as overall_avg
  FROM pair_averages
),
filtered_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    pa.tradekind,
    pa.avg_analyst_count,
    pa.avg_analyst_count - om.overall_avg as margin
  FROM pair_averages pa
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE pa.avg_analyst_count > om.overall_avg
),
trader_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fp.tradekind,
    AVG(fp.avg_analyst_count) as avg_analyst_count_per_type,
    AVG(fp.margin) as avg_margin_per_type
  FROM filtered_pairs fp
  GROUP BY fp.tradekind
),
trader_type_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count_per_type) as mean_across_types
  FROM trader_type_stats
)
SELECT 
  ts.tradekind,
  ts.avg_analyst_count_per_type,
  ts.avg_margin_per_type,
  ts.avg_analyst_count_per_type / tm.mean_across_types as relative_to_mean
FROM trader_type_stats ts
CROSS JOIN trader_type_mean tm
ORDER BY ts.tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: The sentiment snapshot's trader type derives from the transaction's trader (transref → transactionrecord.trdref → trader.tradekind), not from the optional trdref2 field.

alternatives.interpretation: If 'above the overall mean' should include pairs equal to the mean (≥ instead of >), adjust the WHERE clause in filtered_pairs.
